reproduced_on_current_dev.composition: PersonaService composed as core/app_factory.py does (_composed_persona_service), owner transports stubbed, _reconcile_persona_provisioning_once run from a worker thread with no request context, _persona_readback_snapshot NOT stubbed

findings.composition_lead_1: Ruled out by reproduction: outside a request the module-level composed PersonaService resolves the same read store, write owner and provisioning ledger as the route; the background pass promotes to paper_running when the batch snapshot agrees with the owners.
findings.persist_terminal_transition_lead_2: Confirmed difference: the route persisted provisioning_reconciliation_state via persist_terminal_transition, the background pass never did, so the two paths left different Persona metadata for the same readbacks.
findings.batch_binding_decision: Confirmed difference by construction: the background pass used the pass-wide list_all batch whenever it held ANY binding for the plan, and only fell back to list_by_plan when it held none. A lagging non-active row in the batch (for example status pending while Runtime Manager already reports active) kept binding_ok false with no failure, so the Persona stayed provisioning until the 600s timeout. The route always reads list_by_plan. The pass now re-reads the plan directly unless the batch already holds an active binding.

not_proven: The hosted canary (persona-325979a0177bc948366d) logs were not available to this task, so that the lagging-batch condition is the exact hosted cause is not proven. New diagnostics (metadata.provisioning_readback_summary) will name the unmet condition on the next hosted canary.

diagnostics.content: condition names, small integer counts and fixed dependency names only; rewritten when changed or older than 60s

fail_closed: Unchanged: missing/stale heartbeat, missing schedule, mismatched binding still keep or fail the Persona; timeout unchanged. Direct plan read only replaces the batch when it returns bindings.
operator_verification: Hosted canary after deployment is performed by the operator.
